did: Built and tested live in the browser pane by hand. Four old records (three staff activity lines and one sign-in record, 13 to 20 months old) were added to the test data. The owner opened the new Archive screen, pressed Move old records now, and searched for napa.

checks.text: The Archive screen says how many months old a record must be before it moves (12 to start, a setting; 0 for never), that nothing is deleted, and that orders, memos, money and stock are never moved
Move old records now moved the four old records and said so; the counts show 3 staff activity lines and 1 sign-in; the busy tables no longer hold them
Searching for napa found the one activity line that mentioned it, with its date; a search takes every word, a kind of record and a date range, and a percent sign is only a character

At night (03:00 Bangladesh time) the same move runs by itself; running it twice never copies a record twice; only records a person has already read leave the notices; only the people who may read the activity log can open it (automatic tests)

notes: Built this round from the spec (chapter 28, note 11). What moves is only what daily work no longer reads: the staff activity log, sign-in records and notices already read. Behaviour data, orders and money stay where they are. New table archived_records keeps each record whole. 10 new automatic tests.
